::: {.callout-important appearance="simple"}
The syllabus states it plainly: **no individual or group assignments are required**. Nothing on this page is graded and nothing is handed in. It exists because the exam has a coding part, and the only way that part goes well is if you have typed the code before.
:::

## How to use this page

Each set goes live after the lecture it belongs to. A set is small on purpose — 30 to 45 minutes, one dataset, a handful of questions. Solutions are posted one week later.

Work in R unless a set says otherwise — see [Setup](setup.qmd) if your machine is not ready. Bring what breaks to [office hours](office-hours.qmd) — a broken script is a better question than a vague one.
